messages.title: ECRS deployed
messages.text: ERCOT deployed ECRS at 100% of awards from 17:20 to 20:22.

messages.content: I’ll keep the battery full for the high-value evening ECRS awards, use daytime meter headroom for reserves, then discharge in hours 20–21 and recharge to meet the end-of-day target. The dry run is feasible and projects about $1.45 million before real-time deviations or reserve deployments.
ERCOT has deployed ECRS through 17:20. That is projected to draw about 22.7 MWh from the battery. I’ll schedule replenishment before hour 19 to keep the fixed 100 MW ECRS award fully backed.

ERCOT’s renewed ECRS deployment has drawn more energy than the earlier projection. I’ll reduce scheduled discharge to the remaining available energy and retain the late recharge. The current projection shows no failure-to-provide charge and a 100 MWh ending SoC.
